```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
dat_prelim <- read.csv(here::here("P2/DataRaw", "PrelimData.csv"))
```

Correlations
```{r}
summary(dat_prelim)
pairs(dat_prelim)

# Correlations
cor_matrix <- cor(dat_prelim, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cor_matrix

ggplot(melt(cor_matrix), aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  ) + 
  labs(title = "Correlation heatmap",
       x = "", y = "")
```

```{r}
### Extract correlations of interest
r_IL6_CT   <- cor(dat_prelim$IL_6,   dat_prelim$CORT_CNG3,   use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
r_IL6_CVLT <- cor(dat_prelim$IL_6,   dat_prelim$CVLT_CNG3, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
r_MCP1_CT  <- cor(dat_prelim$MCP_1,  dat_prelim$CORT_CNG3,   use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
r_MCP1_CVLT<- cor(dat_prelim$MCP_1,  dat_prelim$CVLT_CNG3, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

### Convert to partial R2 (approximate)
# Assume baseline–Year1 correlation ~0.8 (range 0.6–0.9 in sensitivity)
baseline_corr <- 0.8
adj_factor <- (1 - baseline_corr^2)

partial_R2_IL6_CT <- r_IL6_CT^2 * adj_factor
partial_R2_IL6_CVLT <- r_IL6_CVLT^2 * adj_factor

### Power calculations
library(pwr)

# Example for Aim 1
f2 <- partial_R2_IL6_CT / (1 - partial_R2_IL6_CT)
pwr.f2.test(u = 1,
            v = 125 - 1 - 5,
            f2 = f2,
            sig.level = 0.05)

# Example for Aim 2 interaction
partial_R2_int <- 0.02  # plausible range from literature
f2_int <- partial_R2_int / (1 - partial_R2_int)

pwr.f2.test(u = 1,
            v = 125 - 1 - 6,
            f2 = f2_int,
            sig.level = 0.05)
```
